result.instructions: Tools for Pipedrive, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pipedrive data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run pipedrive_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pipedrive_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pipedrive_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. pipedrive_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals, optionally filtered by filter/owner/person/org/pipeline/stage/status and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals.

filter_id.description: Filter by a saved filter id.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: Get a single deal by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_deals
tools.title: Search deals
tools.description: Search deals by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/search.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to search — any of 'custom_fields', 'notes', 'title'.

person_id.description: Restrict to deals linked to this person id.

organization_id.description: Restrict to deals linked to this organization id.

status.description: Restrict to deals with this status — 'open', 'won' or 'lost'.

exact_match.description: If true, only exact matches (case-insensitive) are returned.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities (tasks/events), optionally filtered by filter/owner/deal/person/org/done/updated_since. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/activities.

filter_id.description: Filter by a saved filter id.

done.description: Filter by completion — true for done, false for not done.

updated_since.description: Only activities updated after this RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_items
tools.title: Search items
tools.description: Global search across multiple item types (deals, persons, organizations, products, leads, files, etc.). Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/itemSearch.

item_types.description: Comma-separated item types to search — any of 'deal', 'person', 'organization', 'product', 'lead', 'file', 'mail_attachment', 'project'.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to search within (depends on item types).

search_for_related_items.description: If true, also return items related to the matches (e.g. deals of a matched person).

exact_match.description: If true, only exact matches (case-insensitive) are returned.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile (name, email, company, locale, timezone). Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally filtered by user/deal/person/org/lead. Uses v1 (v2 has no notes endpoint) with start+limit pagination. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v1/notes.

user_id.description: Filter by the note author (user) id.

lead_id.description: Filter by linked lead id (a UUID string).

tools.name: pipedrive_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: Create a new deal. `title` is required; link it to a person/org/pipeline/stage/owner as needed. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/deals.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). `name` is required; `email`/`phone` are convenience strings mapped to Pipedrive's structured emails/phones arrays. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/persons.

email.description: Primary email address (mapped to the emails array).

phone.description: Primary phone number (mapped to the phones array).

tools.name: pipedrive_create_activity
tools.title: Create activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (task/event). `subject` is required; link it to a deal/person/org and set type/date/time as needed. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/activities.

done.description: Whether the activity is already marked done.

note.description: Free-text note attached to the activity.

tools.name: pipedrive_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: Add a note, linked to at least one of a deal/person/organization/lead. `content` is required (HTML or plain text). Uses v1 (v2 has no notes endpoint). Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v1/notes.

content.description: Note body — HTML or plain text (required).

lead_id.description: Attach to this lead id (a UUID string).
